fact: A despacho of the Cabo Verde Vice-Prime Minister and Minister of Digital Economy designated Cabo Verde Telecom as the national special purpose vehicle in the international consortium for the Amílcar Cabral submarine cable, under the memorandum of understanding between six ECOWAS states (Cabo Verde, Gambia, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Liberia, Sierra Leone).
title: Extrato do Despacho n.º 2/GMED/2025 (Boletim Oficial n.º 143, II Série)
